shortDescription: Route-backed home entry that supports the dashboard home and user profile overview views.
fullDescription: Renders the main application entry as a route-selectable view surface using the optional view search parameter. The route supports the dashboard-home default state with a dark developer dashboard showing overview metrics, recent activity, repository snapshots, and a daily agenda, and it also supports the user-profile-overview default state with a GitHub-inspired profile layout, interactive repository search, tab navigation, and contribution controls. The implementation preserves both default view states in one route-driven entry instead of replacing one screen with static markup.
